metas.name: ★ 8.9 · 2024 · Attack on Titan: The Last Attack
metas.description: The fate of the world hangs in the balance as Eren unleashes the ultimate power of the Titans. With a burning determination to eliminate all who threaten Eldia, he leads an unstoppable army of Colossal Titans towards Marley.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Infinity Castle
metas.description: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank Hindi mein demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc
metas.description: A direct sequel to the first season of the series "Chainsaw Man", featuring Denji, a young man who co-exists with a chainsaw demon. Denji encounters a new romantic interest, but will his involvement place them both in danger?

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2025 · Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2024 · Manjummel Boys
metas.description: A group of friends get into a daring rescue mission to save their friend from Guna Caves, a perilously deep pit from where nobody has ever been brought back.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2024 · Hanu Man
metas.description: An imaginary place called Anjanadri where the protagonist gets the powers of Hanuman and fights for Anjanadri.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Eko
metas.description: In misty Kaattukunnu hills, an elderly woman and her caretaker confront past memories while a hunted dog breeder named Kuriyachan eludes capture. As searchers arrive, buried secrets emerge.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2024 · The Count of Monte Cristo
metas.description: After escaping from an island prison where he spent 14 years for being wrongly accused of state treason, Edmond Dantès returns as the count of Monte Cristo to exact revenge on the men who betrayed him.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2024 · Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba - To the Hashira Training
metas.description: Tanjiro undergoes rigorous training with the Stone Hashira, Himejima, in his quest to become a Hashira. Meanwhile, Muzan continues to search for Nezuko and Ubuyashiki.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2024 · The Goat Life
metas.description: An Indian man seeking work follows a job lead to Saudi Arabia, only to find himself forced to labor without pay as a goat herder in the remote desert.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2024 · Captain Miller
metas.description: A man leaves and turns against the British-led Indian military after witnessing atrocity.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2024 · Kalki 2898 AD
metas.description: A pregnant woman comes under the protection of an immortal warrior while being tracked down by bounty hunters.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Sirat
metas.description: A father, accompanied by his son, goes looking for his missing daughter in the Moroccan desert. After a rave at which she might have been seen, the duo joins the party's proprietors on its way to its next gig in hopes of finding her.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2024 · A.R.M
metas.description: Set in the Northern Kerala in 1900, 1950 and 1990, three generations of heroes, Maniyan, Kunjikelu and Ajayan, try to protect the most important treasure of the land.
